benefits.name: Rallying Cry
benefits.summary: When rolling Initiative while not Incapacitated, grant Heroic Inspiration to up to Proficiency Bonus visible creatures within 30 feet. Once per Long Rest.
benefits.text: When you roll Initiative and aren't Incapacitated, you can give Heroic Inspiration to up to a number of allies equal to your Proficiency Bonus who are within 30 feet and whom you can see. Once per Long Rest. In a fight it happens on its own, to the nearest allies without Heroic Inspiration, unless you turn it Off in the class tab.
